question: What are the top 3 product categories by revenue for customers in the state of RJ?
generated_sql:
SELECT p.product_category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND c.customer_state = 'RJ'
GROUP BY p.product_category
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3
gold_sql:
SELECT p.product_category
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY p.product_category
ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC
LIMIT 3

question: How many unique customers have placed more than one order?
generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_multiple_orders
FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
    HAVING order_cnt > 1
) sub
gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers
FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1
) t
